name: Abu (Japan)
description: A maroon field charged at the centre with the Abu town emblem in white: a disc crossed by a stylised horizontal device with a white notch.
history: Municipal flag of Abu, a town in Yamaguchi Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 November 1966.

features.role: Abu town emblem — a disc crossed by a stylised horizontal device with a white notch
